description: SIFTEC compat suite, offered only when SIFTEC is loaded. Uses SIFTEC's own test commands (op needed).

scenes.title: SIFTEC factory: the buildings_a row of work-package-5 buildings (built once, marked by bedrock at 1190 160 970)
setup: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 1180 960 1290 1040
execute in minecraft:overworld unless block 1190 160 970 minecraft:bedrock run siftec worldtest buildings_a view 0
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 1190 160 970 minecraft:bedrock

scenes.title: The Sift (Mielon's The Sift dimension; its own clock pinned too)
setup: execute in the_sift:the_sift run time set 6000
execute in the_sift:the_sift positioned 0.5 0 0.5 positioned over motion_blocking run tp @a ~ ~4 ~ 45 20

scenes.title: SIFTEC HUB screen
setup: item replace entity @a weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air

screen.prompt: Right-click the HUB in front of you

scenes.title: SIFTEC MAM screen
setup: item replace entity @a weapon.mainhand with minecraft:air

screen.prompt: Right-click the MAM in front of you

scenes.title: SIFTEC fullscreen map, centred on a pinned player

prepare: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 1180 960 1290 1040
execute in minecraft:overworld unless block 1190 160 970 minecraft:bedrock run siftec worldtest buildings_a view 0
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 1190 160 970 minecraft:bedrock
prepareNote: Run once per CI session before any screenshot: builds the factory row so its lighting has settled. The factory scene builds it too (only when the marker block under the platform is missing).
